body.en:
Question B-002-009-011.

Why the correct answer is right: CHU, WWV, and WWVH provide accurate and precise frequency and time signals useful for checking station time and frequency.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "Provide received signal reports of your transmissions": They do not listen to your transmissions and issue received signal reports.
- sourceIndex 2: "Provide forecasts of band conditions": Propagation forecasts are a different information service from standard time and frequency signals.
- sourceIndex 3: "Provide amateur radio bulletins": Amateur bulletins are not the Basic-bank usefulness of these standard stations.
